//: Disable the bakers@bakers marketplace plugin inside the bakers repository itself. The marketplace is registered as a *directory* in ~/.claude/plugins/known_marketplaces.json pointing to the main checkout, and Claude Code installs it as a frozen snapshot under ~/.claude/plugins/cache/bakers/bakers/<version>. Working in this repo means working on the skill sources, so the sources must win: the plugin ships a stale copy of the very files under .claude/skills/bakers-build/skills/, and a plugin beats anything a project links or re-registers. Keep the plugin enabled globally -- other projects consume bakers skills through it. This committed setting is inherited by this repository's worktrees; the committed playground fixture carries the same opt-out for its own worktrees.
